items.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: It must have been my Shorty Rogers period.

ctx.x: You‟re credited with tenor and bari on this one. This is also live at the Rendevous Ballroom, Balboa Beach, but again, this is Shorty Rogers, and a pretty extensive repertoire here. Sometimes I‟m Happy, all the way down, Perdido, Nice Work If You Can Get It, Why Shouldn‟t I?No credits for any of the arranging, but it sounds like . . . .

Then the next one is, again, Shorty. So, are you in Shorty‟s band? Because it‟s Shorty Rogers‟s band. Hot Blood is the next entry. It‟s got Shelly on drums, Jimmy Giuffre, Bob Cooper on bari, Jimmy Knepper.
